attributes.name: carousel pagination indicator style
attributes.definition: How the carousel shows which slide is active and how many slides exist.

values.definition: Small circular dots, active filled and inactive outlined.
Dots distinguished by opacity or color only.

attributes.name: carousel slide arrangement
attributes.definition: How slides are positioned relative to each other in the carousel.

values.definition: All slides occupy the same position, overlapping fully, with only the active one visible.
Slides laid out side by side in a row that slides/scrolls.
